scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請站住！
您攜帶的物品過多，背包空間不足，無法領取獎勵。請騰出一些背包空間後再來接受挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Greetings...
My name is Sir Chilias'Tyus.
I've lived a long time here in
Rune-Midgarts and I've come
to see and know a lot of things. Power, jealously, hardship...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
你好...
我是奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士。
我在盧恩·米德加茲生活了很久，
見證並經歷了許多事情。力量、嫉妒、苦難...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what exactly
brings you here to
the middle of Morocc?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，究竟是什麼
把你帶到
莫洛克的中心呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
This land has grown corrupt
with the diseases of greed
and selfishness. Everywhere
you go, people are heartless,
but I still believe that I'll find the one worthy enough to help me...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
這片土地已被貪婪
和自私的毒瘤所侵蝕。無論走到哪裡，
人們都變得冷酷無情，
但我依然相信，我會找到那個足夠優秀、能助我一臂之力的人...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
There is no shortage of
brave and strong warriors
in these dangerous times.
But for the thing I seek,
I must have the help of one
who is truly pure of heart...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
在這個危險的時代，
勇敢而強大的戰士並不少見。
但對於我所尋找的東西，
我必須依靠一個
內心真正純潔的人...

scripts.text: What are you looking for?
scripts.translation: 你在尋找什麼？

scripts.text: Pure of heart? Hah! Good luck!
scripts.translation: 內心純潔？哈！祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Heh heh~ I see your eyes
glimmer with enthusiasm,
but it seems this task might
be a little too much for you.
I'm sorry, but that's the
reality I can't ignore...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
呵呵~ 我看到你眼中閃爍著熱情，
但這任務對你來說可能有點太難了。
很抱歉，這是我無法忽視的現實...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Go out in to the world,
and grow in strength.
Perhaps after you become
more capable, I'll find that
I can rely on your help.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
去外面的世界歷練吧，
變得更強。
也許等你變得更有能力後，
我會發現可以依靠你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I suppose I should tell you
first about my grandfather,
who was once a young and
feareless adventurer, much
like yourself. Yes, he traveled the world with his three friends...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我想我應該先告訴你
關於我祖父的事，
他曾經也是一位年輕
且無畏的冒險者，
和你很像。是的，他曾與三位好友周遊世界...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
The four of them went on
many expeditions together
and earned themselves a
reputation as a courageous
team that worked especially
well together after many years.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
他們四人一起進行了
許多探險，並憑藉
多年默契的配合，
贏得了勇敢團隊的
美名。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Then, on what was supposed
to be a typical journey, they found an uncharted cave. Curious, and
in need of rest, the four ventured inside. There, they encountered
that most horrible creature...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
然後，在一次看似普通的旅途中，他們發現了一個未標記的洞穴。出於好奇，
又需要休息，四人便走了進去。在那裡，他們遇到了
那個最可怕的生物...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It was a ferocious beast
with horns as large and as
sharp as their weapons, with
eyes that blazed with hellfire.
My grandfather could tell that
it was thirsty for blood.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
那是一頭兇猛的野獸，
長著像武器一樣巨大且鋒利的角，
雙眼燃燒著地獄之火。
我祖父能感覺到，
它渴望鮮血。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
They ran from the beast
as quickly as they could,
but the four were separated
in the cave's darkness. It was
all they could do to hide in
the darkness of the cave...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
他們拼命逃離野獸，
但在洞穴的黑暗中，
四人走散了。他們只能
躲在洞穴的黑暗角落裡...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
From his hiding place, my
grandfather heard the screams
of his friends as the monster
slaughtered them, one by one.
The screams and the monster's
growls were getting closer...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
從藏身處，我祖父
聽到了朋友們被魔物
一個個屠殺的尖叫聲。
尖叫聲和魔物的咆哮聲
越來越近...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Unable to endure the
suffering of his trusted
comrades, my grandfather
jumped out hiding and tried
to save his friends. The beast
found him and they battled.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
無法忍受
信任的同志們
遭受痛苦，我祖父
衝出藏身處，試圖
拯救他的朋友們。野獸
發現了他，他們展開了戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It was no use. The beast
was too powerful and my
grandfather was knocked out.
When he came to, his friends
were all dead and a shining
gem lay in a pool of blood.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
毫無用處。野獸
太強大了，我祖父
被打暈了過去。
當他醒來時，朋友們
都已死去，一灘血泊中
躺著一顆發光的寶石。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
My grandfather buried
his friends that day. He
took that gem as a memento
of their final expedition, but
wondered why the beast
had decided to spare him.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我祖父在那天
埋葬了他的朋友們。他
帶走了那顆寶石，作為
他們最後一次探險的紀念，
但他想知道，為什麼野獸
決定放過他。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It wasn't long before he
experienced the gem's curse
firsthand. The gem inexplicably
drew people to it, taking the
greed in their hearts and
twisting their minds...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
沒過多久，他就
親身體驗了寶石的詛咒。
寶石莫名其妙地
吸引人們靠近，
利用他們心中的貪婪
扭曲他們的思想...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Grandfather believed the
beast let him live so that
the gem would be set loose
upon the outside world, free
to pollute it with its evil. He had to do something...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
祖父認為，野獸
讓他活著，是為了
讓寶石流入外界，
自由地用邪惡汙染世界。他必須做點什麼...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
However, the gem proved
to be formed out of pure evil
and could not be destroyed
by human means. In the end,
my grandfather hid the gem
someplace safe...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
然而，這顆寶石被證明是由純粹的邪惡凝聚而成，無法通過人力摧毀。最終，我的祖父將它藏在了一個安全的地方...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
However, the threat of the
gem still exists. Grandfather
and my father worked for years to find a way to seal its darkness.
Only now have I been able to create a bracelet to seal its evil power.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
不過，寶石的威脅依然存在。祖父和父親花費了數年時間尋找封印其黑暗的方法。直到如今，我才終於製作出一隻能夠封印其邪惡力量的手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
For my grandfather and his
friends to truly rest in peace,
I must find an adventurer of
pure heart who can find the
gem and bring it to me so that
I can finally seal its power.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
為了讓祖父和他的朋友們真正安息，我必須找到一位擁有純愛之心的冒險者，找到那顆寶石並帶給我，這樣我才能最終封印它的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I think... I think you
might be the hero that
I've been waiting for. Will
you help an old man for the
sake of all that is good?
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我想...我想您或許就是我一直等待的英雄。為了世間一切美好，您願意幫助一位老人嗎？

scripts.text: Of course, I will.
scripts.translation: 當然，我願意。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Good, good, but first
I must test to see if you
are worthy of holding the
Hellion's gem. I can't tell
you exactly where it is, but
I will give you some clues.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
很好，很好。但首先，我必須測試一下您是否有資格持有地獄犬的寶石。我無法告訴您它的確切位置，但我會給您一些線索。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
First, speak to Clanux
Heffron in Prontera. He
has offered to help me find
the gem, but I do not know if
I can trust him. Please help me protect this world from the gem...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
首先，去普隆德拉找克拉努克斯·赫夫倫對話。他表示願意協助我尋找寶石，但我不知道是否值得信任他。請幫助我保護這個世界，免受寶石的侵害...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I understand...
I know I am asking much
of you, and this task is not
one to take lightly. However,
I believe that you are wholly
capable of accomplishing this.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我理解...
我知道這對您要求很高，這項任務也不容輕視。然而，我相信您完全有能力完成它。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Times are bad when
even the youth have
been jaded. But I refuse
to believe that hope is
truly lost in this age...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
世風日下，連年輕人都變得世故了。但我拒絕相信，在這個時代希望真的已經消逝...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please seek out
Clanux Heffron in
Prontera. He may have
information regarding a
clue leading to the Hellion
gem. Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
請去普隆德拉尋找克拉努克斯·赫夫倫。他可能有關於地獄犬寶石線索的資訊。祝您好運。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
So have you considered
my proposal? I believe that
you may be the one who will
help me in sealing away the
Hellion gem's evil forever.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
那麼，您考慮過我的提議了嗎？我相信，您就是那個能幫我永遠封印地獄犬寶石邪惡力量的人。

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我會幫您的。

scripts.text: ...Sorry about that.
scripts.translation: ...抱歉，我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Good, good, but first
I must test to see if you
are worthy of holding the
Hellion's gem. I can't tell
you exactly where it is, but
I will give you some clues.

I believe that you are wholly

scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我理解...
我知道這對您要求很高，這項任務也不容輕視。然而，我相信您完全有能力完成它。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Try to see what you can
learn from Clanux Heffron.
I don't know how cooperative
he will be, but I'm sure that
he'll tell you something one
way or another.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
試著從克拉努克斯·赫夫倫那裡打聽一下。我不知道他會配合到什麼程度，但我相信無論如何他都會透露一些資訊的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Ah, yes! This is one piece
of the tablet that will lead
you to the Hellion's gem!
This engraving was definitely
made by my grandfather, and Christopher was one of his friends.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
啊，是的！這是指引您找到地獄犬寶石的石板碎片之一！這上面的雕刻絕對是我祖父留下的，而克里斯托弗正是他的朋友之一。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I suppose he hid these pieces
in the places that reminded him
of his friends. Now according
to the tablet's message, you
should find the next piece in ''the city of thickest forest.''
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我想他是把這些碎片藏在了讓他想起朋友的地方。根據石板上的資訊，您應該在“森林最茂密的城市”找到下一塊碎片。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I'm sure that the
next tablet piece is
in Payon, so go there
and see if you can find
it. Good luck to you,
kind adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我確信下一塊石板碎片在斐揚，所以請去那裡看看能否找到它。祝您好運，善良的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Now that I think about
it, there's a guy in Payon
that I know named Grout'the
Tuccok who knew my grandfather.
He might know something, but
he's a little, well... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
仔細想想，斐揚有個叫格魯特·圖科克的傢伙，他認識我的祖父。他可能知道些什麼，但他有點...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I think you're doing
a good job in finding
those clues in Payon.
Please do your best in
finding the rest of the
pieces of that tablet.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我覺得您在斐揚尋找線索做得很好。請繼續努力，找到那塊石板的其餘碎片。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
While you were gone,
I felt a little bad that you
were searching for the
tablets pieces on your own,
so I managed to find this
piece here in Morocc. But...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
您不在的時候，
我有些過意不去，
讓您獨自尋找石板碎片，
所以我在摩洛克找到了這一塊。但是...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Why are they glowing like
this? In any case, we have
this piece I found here in
Morocc, and the pieces you
found in Prontera and Payon. There's one more left in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
為什麼它們會這樣發光？
總之，我們有我在摩洛克找到的這一塊，
還有您在普隆德拉和斐揚找到的碎片。
吉芬還剩下最後一塊。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Anyway, on the tablet
piece that I found, it
says ''Hakim loved magic,
and always enjoyed its
wondrous city,'' so I'm sure
the last piece is in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
總之，在我找到的這塊石板碎片上
寫著“哈基姆熱愛魔法，
並總是享受他那座神奇的城市”，
所以我確信最後一塊碎片在吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please, take this third
tablet piece and find the
final piece so that we can
fulfill my dear grandfather's
greatest wish and forever
seal away the Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
請收下這塊第三塊石板碎片，
並找到最後一塊，
這樣我們才能實現我親愛的祖父
最大的願望，
永遠封印地獄犬的寶石。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
When you get to Geffen,
please speak to Welshyun,
who's been helping me in
creating a device to seal the
gem's darkness. He is worthy of trust and will surely help us.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
到了吉芬後，
請去對話威爾什雲，
他一直在幫我製造
封印寶石黑暗之力的裝置。
他是值得信賴的人，一定會幫我們的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Where are the tablet pieces?
Have you hoarded them away
to steal the Hellion's gem
for yourself?! I must smite
you now before you are
consumed by its darkness!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
石板碎片在哪裡？
難道你私藏起來，
想自己偷走地獄犬的寶石嗎？！
在你被黑暗吞噬之前，
我必須立刻盾擊你！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please visit the
sage named Welshyun
in Geffen. We are good
friends, so I am sure
that you can trust him.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
請去吉芬拜訪
名叫威爾什雲的賢者。
我們是好朋友，
所以我確信你可以信任他。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
You have all four
pieces of the tablet?
That's great news! Ah,
and the gem is embedded
in each of the tablet pieces.
We're so close to finishing!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
你集齊了四塊石板碎片？
這是好訊息！啊，
而且每塊石板碎片上都鑲嵌著寶石。
我們要大功告成了！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Ah, would you go back
to Welshyun? I know it's
a hassle, but he is probably
the only one who can combine
the tablet pieces into the its
complete form. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
啊，你能再回去找威爾什雲嗎？
我知道這很麻煩，
但他可能是唯一能把石板碎片
拼合成完整形態的人。謝謝你...

Where are the tablet pieces?
Have you hoarded them away
to steal the Hellion's gem
for yourself?! I must smite
you now before you are
consumed by its darkness!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
石板碎片在哪裡？
難道你私藏起來，
想自己偷走地獄犬的寶石嗎？！
在你被黑暗吞噬之前，
我必須立刻盾擊你！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Ah, would you go back
to Welshyun? I know it's
a hassle, but he is probably
the only one who can combine
the tablet pieces into the its
complete form. Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
啊，你能再回去找威爾什雲嗎？
我知道這很麻煩，
但他可能是唯一能把石板碎片
拼合成完整形態的人。謝謝你...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
At long last. We have
everything. The Tablet
and the Hellion's gem.
Now I can finally use
this bracelet to seal
its power forever...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
終於。我們擁有了一切。
石板和地獄犬的寶石。
現在我終於可以用
這個手鐲永遠封印它的力量了...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
But your eyes...
They seem so tired
and I can sense some
sort of pain from them.
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
但是你的眼睛...
看起來非常疲憊，
我能感覺到其中蘊含的某種痛苦。
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I learned the secret of
the Hellion's gem. It...
It turns people into
Hellion Revenants.
It's what happened
to your grandfather...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得知了地獄犬寶石的秘密。它...
它會把人變成暗黑祭司。
這就是發生在你祖父身上的事...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
What...
What did you just say?
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
什麼...
你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The tablet had a map that
let me to the chamber where
your grandfather locked himself
up before he completed turned
into the Hellion Revenant.
It was horrible...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
石板上有一張地圖，
帶我找到了你祖父在完全變成
暗黑祭司之前將自己鎖起來的那個房間。
那景象太可怕了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At the entrance, he
left a message that said
that he wanted to be killed.
So that he could finally join
his friends instead of living
as a monster. So I... So I...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在入口處，他
留下了一條資訊，說
他希望被殺死。
這樣他就能最終與朋友們團聚，
而不是作為怪物活著。所以我...所以我...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
It's okay. I know you
did the right thing. It's
what my grandfather
would have wanted most.
Thank you for finally freeing
his soul and giving him peace.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
沒關係。我知道你
做了正確的事。這正是
我祖父最希望看到的。
謝謝你終於解放了他的靈魂，
讓他得以安息。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, I think you
should have this Eye
of Hellion, in case you
wanted a memento of
your dear grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給你，我想你
應該收下這隻地獄犬之眼，
如果你想要一件
紀念你親愛的祖父的
紀念物的話。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I'd appreciate that.
Grandfather's eye...
It's full of the painful
experiences of the people
who were turned into Hellion
Revenants against their will.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我很感激。
祖父的眼睛...
它充滿了那些被強行變成
暗黑祭司的人的痛苦經歷。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
But... Now is not the
time for sentiment. For
the sake of my grandfather,
I must seal the power of
the Hellion's gem now!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
但是...現在不是
感傷的時候。為了我祖父，
我必須現在封印地獄犬寶石的力量！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Darkness that writhes,
souls lost in the inferno,
I offer you comfort, I offer
you peace. To the despairing
ones, to the shameless ones,
I give guidance to heaven...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
在煉獄中掙扎的黑暗，
迷失的靈魂，
我賜予你們慰藉，賜予你們安寧。
對於絕望者，對於無恥者，
我指引你們通往天堂...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Instead of sadness,
let there be joy. Instead
of anger, let there be
love. Souls that are
lost will now find
their way...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
願悲傷化為喜悅，
願憤怒化為愛意。
迷失的靈魂啊，
如今將找到歸途...

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Light and hope...
Heaven and earth...
Cast away the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
光明與希望...
天與地...
驅散黑暗吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
I did it.
After all these
long years, I finally did
it. Thanks to your help.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
我做到了。
歷經漫長歲月，
我終於做到了。
多虧了你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Please take this
Nile Rose, which will
keep the power of the gem
in check. I trust that you will
keep its secret and protect it
from those motivated by greed.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
請收下這朵尼羅玫瑰，
它能壓制寶石的力量。
我相信你會保守這個秘密，
並保護它免受貪婪之人的覬覦。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Thank you, kind
adventurer, for bringing
peace to my grandfather's
soul and for working to
protect peace in our world.
You are the truest of heroes.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
謝謝你，善良的冒險者，
你讓我祖父的靈魂得以安息，
並致力於守護世界的和平。
你才是真正的英雄。

tablet? We need that in
order to extract the Hellion's
gem in order to seal its power!
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
完整的石板在哪裡？
我們需要它來提取地獄犬的寶石，
從而封印它的力量！

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
Long time no see. So, are you doing well to keep the promise with me?
Please handle it with care
to prevent the evil power within from being released.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
好久不見。那麼，你遵守與我的約定了嗎？
請小心保管，
防止其中的邪惡力量被釋放。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
You still have the Hellion's Eye.
I can see the pain in your eyes.
Let me lighten your burden. It will be better this way.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
你仍然持有地獄犬之眼。
我能看到你眼中的痛苦。
讓我減輕你的負擔吧。這樣會好一些。

scripts.text:
[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
願上帝保佑你。

[Sir Chilias'Tyus]
... ... ...
scripts.translation:
[奇利亞斯·提烏斯爵士]
... ... ...

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne of the Tablet Pieces
that you have is beginning to
shine with light, as if it were
responding to something...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你持有的一塊石板碎片
開始發出光芒，
彷彿在對某物做出回應...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請站住！
您攜帶的物品過多，背包空間不足，無法領取獎勵。請騰出一些背包空間後再來接受挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
What's wrong with
this map?! I can't
find a blasted thing
on it! How can finding
something be so hard?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
這張地圖怎麼了？！
我什麼都找不到！
找東西怎麼這麼難？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but are
you Clanux Heffron?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，
請問你是克拉努克斯·赫夫倫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Why, who are you
and what the heck
do you want? Oh...
Sent by Chilias, eh?
What does he want?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
啊，你是誰，
想幹什麼？哦...
是奇利亞斯派你來的？
他有什麼事？

scripts.text: He wants me to help you.
scripts.translation: 他想讓我幫你。

scripts.text: He wants you to help me.
scripts.translation: 他想讓你幫我。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
So he sent me an
assistant, huh? Well...
Seeing as he gave me this
clue and I've taken so long
and still don't have anything to show for it, I don't blame him.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
原來他給我派了個助手啊。好吧...
既然他給了我線索，
而我花了這麼久卻毫無進展，
我也不能怪他。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Well, if he sent you to
help me out, I guess I can
tell you everything. For the
clues he had me look for,
I've only found two so far.
But I can't figure them out...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
好吧，既然他派你來幫我，
我想我可以把一切都告訴你。
關於他讓我尋找的線索，
我目前只找到了兩個。
但我搞不懂它們的意思...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Let's see, there's this
broken sword and this
strange lookin' cogwheel.
What do these clues mean?!
Did the old man give you
any hints to help me out?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
讓我看看，有一把破裂之劍
和一個看起來很奇怪的齒輪。
這些線索是什麼意思？！
那個老頭有沒有給你
什麼提示來幫我？

scripts.text: Where did you find these?
scripts.translation: 你在哪裡找到的？

scripts.text: No, I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 不，對不起。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh, these I found in Prontera.
That old coot hid these real
good. But yeah, I doubt you'd
find anything, but would you try
checking out the old Swordman
Training ground for more clues?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
哦，這些是我在普隆德拉找到的。
那個老傢伙藏得很嚴實。不過我覺得你大概也找不到什麼，但你要不要去舊劍士訓練場找找更多線索？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Man, that Hellion's gem
must really be worth a pretty
penny if the old man went
through so much trouble to
even hide these clues. Oh
man, I want it so bad...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
天哪，如果那個老頭費了這麼大勁去藏這些線索，那地獄犬的寶石一定價值連城吧。唉，我好想要它啊...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Wha--? Then why are
you even here to help
me then? Huh. That old
coot must not trust me
enough, but I can't exactly
blame him. Alright then...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
什...？那你為什麼還在這裡幫我？哼。那個老傢伙肯定不太信任我，但我也不能怪他。好吧...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
If you're gonna help me,
go search the old Swordman
Training Grounds over here in
Prontera. I doubt it, but there's
a chance I mighta missed
something there. Get to it!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
如果你要幫我，就去普隆德拉這邊的舊劍士訓練場找找。雖然我覺得不太可能，但我可能在那裡漏掉了什麼。快去！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Help you...? What, with
clues to the location of
the Hellion's gem? Screw
that, pal! Why should I help
you if we're gonna compete
for the same prize?!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
幫你...？什麼，幫我找地獄犬寶石的下落？免談，夥計！既然我們要爭奪同一個獎品，我為什麼要幫你？！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, why do you keep
botherin' me?! Go and
find your own clues for the
Hellion's gem on your own,
jerkface! Now getouttahere!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
嘿，你為什麼老是纏著我？！自己去找地獄犬寶石的線索吧，你這個討厭鬼！現在給我滾！

scripts.text: W-wait! Let's work together!
scripts.translation: 等等！我們要合作！

scripts.text: Fine. I don't need your help!
scripts.translation: 好吧。我不需要你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Work together, eh? You
know, normally I'd tell you
to make like a moonwalker
and just beat it, but I gotta
admit that I ain't doin' so
good on my own on this...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
合作，是嗎？你知道的，平時我會讓你像月球漫步者一樣趕緊滾蛋，但我得承認，我自己一個人進展並不順利...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Alright, fine.
First, look through
the old Swordman Training
Grounds here in Prontera.
There might be some clues left over there for you to find...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
好吧，行吧。
首先，去查查普隆德拉這邊的舊劍士訓練場。
那裡可能還剩下一些線索供你發現...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine.
I don't need
your help!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧。
我不需要
你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Clannux Heffron]
Yeah right!
You'll be back!
...They always
come back.
scripts.translation:
[克蘭努克斯·赫夫倫]
少來！
你遲早會回來的！
...他們總是
會回來的。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Look pal, I found this broken
sword, a bonafide clue if I ever saw one, in the old Swordman
Training Grounds in Prontera.
You should be able to find
something else there... maybe.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
聽著，夥計，我在普隆德拉的舊劍士訓練場找到了這把破裂之劍，這可是個貨真價實的線索。你應該也能在那裡找到點別的...也許吧。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, you're done
searching? Were you
able to find anything?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
嘿，你搜完了？
你找到什麼了嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing...
scripts.translation: 什麼也沒找到...

scripts.text: In fact, I found this.
scripts.translation: 實際上，我找到了這個。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333(This guy's a real punk!
I better not share any new
information I've found, just
in case he doesn't already
know about it.)^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333(這傢伙真是個朽魔！
為了以防萬一，
我最好別分享我新找到的任何資訊，
萬一他不知道呢。)^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I... I wasn't able to
find anything that looked
like a clue. I'm sorry, but
I let you down big time...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...我沒能找到任何看起來像線索的東西。對不起，我讓你失望了...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Aw nuts! Alright, if you
go back to the old man, let
him know that I found a broken
sword from the old Swordman
Training Grounds and this
cogwheel from the Tool Shop.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
該死！好吧，如果你回去找那個老人，告訴他我在劍士訓練場發現了一把斷劍，還有在工具店發現了一個齒輪。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
The clues I've found so
far don't make any sense!
So if you can, convince him to
drop me a couple more hints.
And give this to the old guy
to prove I found it, will you?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
我目前找到的線索完全講不通！所以如果你能的話，說服他再給我幾個提示。還有，把這個給那個老頭，證明是我找到的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
That's all I know.
At this point you're
probably better off
searching for these
clues on your own...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
我就知道這麼多。
到現在為止，
你最好還是自己
去搜尋這些線索...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
So that's what you
found? Huh. I'm even
more confused. Alright.
Well, I found a broken
sword in the Swordman
Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
所以這就是你找到的？嗯。我更加困惑了。好吧。
我在劍士訓練場發現了一把斷劍。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh, and I also found
this old cogwheel in the
Tool Shop around here.
Here, just take it. Maybe
you'll have better luck
figuring out what it means.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
哦，我還在附近的工具店發現了這個舊齒輪。
拿去，拿著吧。也許
你能更幸運地
弄清楚它的意思。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
But once you do
learn anything new,
to me and let me know!
That's an order, got it?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
但一旦你
瞭解到任何新東西，
告訴我！
這是命令，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey... Didn't I tell
you to check out the
Tool Shop in case there
was anything I missed?
Now go! That's an order!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
嘿... 我不是讓你
去查查工具店，
看看有沒有我漏掉的東西嗎？
現在快去！這是命令！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Wha--? I had no idea
that sort of thing could
be hidden in that training
I missed it. Oh, so the Veggie Lady gave you a password and all?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
什--？我完全不知道
那種東西可以藏在
那個訓練場裡。
我漏掉了。哦，所以賣菜的女士給了你一個密碼？

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Huh, I can't make heads
or tails of that password.
I guess I have no choice but
to give you this, the cogwheel clue I found from the Tool Shop.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
嗯，我完全搞不懂那個密碼。
看來我別無選擇，
只能把這個給你了，
我在工具店找到的齒輪線索。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
I mean, you've been lucky
enough till now, so you'll
probably be able to stumble
upon the answer behind this
weird, weird riddle. But you
gotta tell me the answer too!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
我是說，你到目前為止
運氣夠好了，
所以你應該能
碰巧解開這個
奇怪、奇怪的謎題。但你
必須把答案也告訴我！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Alright, now take your
cogwheel and get outta
here. The sooner you get
that clue, the sooner I'll
get that Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
好了，拿著你的
齒輪，滾出去。
你越快得到
那個線索，
我就能越快得到
那個地獄之石。

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Hey, hurry up and check
the Tool Shop and figure
out the meaning of that
password! Maybe that weird
machine there is a part of
this whole puzzle? Nah...
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
嘿，快點去查
工具店，弄清楚那個
密碼的意思！也許那裡那個
奇怪的機器是
整個謎題的一部分？不...

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]

Didja find anything
new in the Tool Shop?
scripts.translation:

嘿...
你在工具店
發現什麼新東西了嗎？

scripts.text: Pretend that nothing happened.

scripts.text: Share what you learned.
scripts.translation: 分享你學到的東西。

[{0}]

new leads. I guess

go back to Chilias'Tyus,

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

我沒找到任何
新線索。看來
我別無選擇，

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]

are you anyway, huh?
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
該死！
真沒用！
你到底是什麼樣的
助手啊，哼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I put that cogwheel
into that weird machine in
the Tool Shop and some kind
of number pad came out. Then...

the password was. I'm stuck!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我把那個齒輪
放進了工具店那個
奇怪的機器裡，然後

呃，我搞不懂
密碼是什麼。我卡住了！

scripts.text:
[Clanux Heffron]
Oh yeah? Hah! Well, now

password myself! Hahaha! That Hellion's gem is as good as mine!
scripts.translation:
[克拉努克斯·赫夫倫]
哦是嗎？哈！好吧，
既然簡單的部分完成了，
我就自己解開那個
秘密密碼吧！哈哈哈！那個地獄之石
已經是我的了！

如果我都解不開，

by the thrust of a sharp sword.^000000

身上有一道裂口，
看起來像是被鋒利的劍刺穿的。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]

found a broken sword around

[{0}]
克拉努克斯不是提到他

scripts.text: Inspect the dummy's gash
scripts.translation: 檢查假人的裂口

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside of the dummy's body is
a steel bearing with a roughly
etched message that reads:^000000
^4d4dff''Veggie Lady N9 W3 BINGO.''^000000
scripts.translation:

有一個鋼製軸承，上面粗糙地刻著一條資訊：^000000
^4d4dff“賣菜的女士 N9 W3 BINGO。”^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the heck does this
even mean? A Veggie Lady?
Does Clanux know anything
at all about this clue...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這到底是什麼意思？賣菜的女士？
克拉努克斯知道這個線索的任何資訊嗎...？

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a training dummy
that was used to hone the
skills of new Swordmen...
But the Swordman Training
Grounds have moved to Izlude.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一個用來磨練
新晉劍士技能的訓練假人...
但劍士訓練場已經搬到依斯魯得島了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, according to the
message in that old training
dummy, this is where I'm
supposed to go. Nine steps
north, 3 steps west. And now...
Veggie Lady. Okay, okay...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，根據那個舊訓練假人裡的資訊，
我應該去這裡。向北九步，向西三步。然後...
賣菜的女士。好的，好的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh. That's creepy.
There's one right there
staring at me. But after
the words ''Veggie Lady,''
all the message says is, um,
what was that last word again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯。真嚇人。
那裡有一個正盯著我看。但在“賣菜的女士”之後，
資訊只說了，呃，
最後一個詞是什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course!
''BINGO!'' But
I don't see a hall
full of old people
around here, I--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然！
“BINGO！”但
我周圍並沒有
滿是老人的大廳，我--

scripts.text:

Finally, you say it.

going to wait forever for
somebody to say that
password. Okay, here's
the code number you want...
scripts.translation:

終於，你說了。
哎呀，我以為我要永遠等下去
才有人說出那個密碼。好了，這是
你想要的程式碼數字...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
C-code number?

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
代-程式碼數字？

I'm only gonna say it

didn't get it:^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000.

[{0}]

this all mean? Won't
you tell me more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...這到底是什麼意思？

No. I've been given
explicit instructions
to not tell you more.
In fact, I hate talking.
That's why I sell vegetables.
scripts.translation:

不行。我接到了明確的指示，
不能告訴你更多。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Holy cow...

really cloak and
dagger type stuff!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...
這一切真是充滿了

Hey...

scripts.translation:

嘿...

just bein' a rude prick
and staring at me like

你可能知道關於
一塊石板碎片的事——

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
What? Oh, so Chilias'Tyus
is lookin for the gem too, eh?
Ooh, that's right. He wants to
seal its evil or something.
Yeah, yeah. That's a good
cause. Real noble and all...
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
什麼？哦，所以奇利亞·提烏斯
也在找那塊寶石，是吧？
噢，對。他想封印它的邪惡
之類的。
是啊，是啊。那是個
高尚的事業。真的很崇高...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Tell you what. The only reason
I want that gem is to sell it so I can pay off all my debts. But
if I sell you the clues I found, I'll get the zeny I need and the
gem will be in good hands too.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
這樣吧。我之所以想要那塊寶石，
只是為了賣掉它來還清我的所有債務。但
如果我把找到的線索賣給你，我就能拿到我需要的Zeny，
而且那塊寶石也會落入可靠的人手中。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
So what do you say?
It's not a bad deal if
you think about it and
we might as well kill
two birds with one stone...
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
所以你覺得怎麼樣？
仔細想想，這可不是
一筆壞交易，
我們不妨
一石二鳥...

scripts.text: Alright, I'll buy your clues.
scripts.translation: 好的，我買你的線索。

scripts.text: Why the hell should I pay you?!
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要付錢給你？！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh man, thanks a lot.
Alright, all I'm asking
for is 10,000 zeny. You get
my clues and I'll let you know
where I found 'em, in case
you can find something new.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
噢，太感謝了。
好吧，我只要求
10,000 Zeny。你得到
我的線索，我會告訴你
我在哪裡找到的，以防
你能發現新的東西。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
There you go!
Thanks for the cash~
(Now I won't have to
get my knees all broken!)
Oh, and let me mark your
Mini-Map for you real quick...
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
給你！
謝謝你的錢~
（這樣我就不會
被打斷腿了！）
哦，讓我快速
在你的小地圖上做個標記...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
You see this here?
It's where I found the
Skirt of Virgin I'm about
to give you. So check that
spot out and see if you find
anything new and interesting.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
你看到這個了嗎？
這就是我即將給你的
韓服發現的地方。所以去檢查
那個地點，看看你是否能
發現任何新的、有趣的東西。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Here you go, pal...
A Stone Heart, Green Herb,
some Grape Juice and one
clean and pure Skirt of Virgin.
If you got any more questions,
I guess you can ask me later~
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
給你，夥計...
一顆石心，一株綠色藥草，
一些葡萄汁和一件
乾淨純粹的韓服。
如果你還有更多問題，
我想你可以稍後再問我~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Whoa whoa...
But you don't got any room
in your inventory to hold
what I wanna give you. It'd
probably be best to stash your
stuff in Kafra Storage, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
哇哦...
但你沒有足夠的背包空間
來裝我想給你的東西。最好
把你的東西
存放在卡普拉倉庫，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh hey...
You don't got the zeny.
Sorry pal, but I've really got
to pay my debts somehow.
I don't know if I'm allowed
to really talk about it...
^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
哦，嘿...
你沒有Zeny。
抱歉，夥計，但我真的
必須想辦法還清我的債務。
我不知道我是否被允許
真的談論這件事...
^333333*抽泣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Why the hell should you
pay me?! Hey, aren't you
looking for the gem to help
the world? Well, I happen to
be a little part of this world,
so why don't you help me first?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
你為什麼
要付錢給我？嘿，你不是
在找寶石來幫助
世界嗎？嗯，我碰巧
是這個世界的
一小部分，
所以為什麼不先幫我？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Man, you might not
know it, but the money
you give me will save
a life. My own! Dude, how
can you be so insensitive?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
夥計，你可能
不知道，但你給我的錢
會拯救一條生命。我自己的！夥計，你
怎麼能這麼不敏感？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
You forgot where I told
you to look for more clues?
Eh, I'll let you know once
again, sure. Keep your eye
on your Mini-Map, got it?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
你忘了我告訴
你去哪裡找更多線索了嗎？
嗯，我再告訴你
一次，沒問題。注意
你的小地圖，明白了？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright...
Good luck out there.
I really hope you can
keep the gem out of the
wrong hands. Of course, I was gonna just sell it, but...
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
好的...
祝你好運。
我真的希望你能
讓那塊寶石
遠離錯誤的人手中。當然，我本來打算賣掉它，但是...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
You've been to the
first location? Good.
Okay, now look over here.
Check your Mini-Map to
see where I found that
Stone Heart, got it?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
你去過
第一個地點了嗎？很好。
好的，現在看這裡。
檢查你的小地圖，
看看我在哪裡找到了那顆
石心，明白了？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright, here's where
I found that Green Herb.
You know you can use that
to counter poison, right?
Check that place to see if
there's anything I missed.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
好的，這就是我
找到那株綠色藥草的地方。
你知道你可以用它
來解毒，對吧？
檢查那個地方，看看
是否有我遺漏的東西。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Okay, here's the last
place you should double
check, the place where
I nabbed that Grape
Juice. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
好的，這是最後一個
你應該再次檢查的地方，
我拿走那瓶葡萄汁的地方。祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh, you need some help
in figuring out the clues?
Heh. Alright, let's see.
You want me to help
you in making sense of
this weird riddle?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
哦，你需要幫忙
解讀這些線索嗎？
嘿，好吧，讓我看看。
你想讓我幫你
理解這個奇怪的謎題？

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 好的，請給我！

scripts.text: No, thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright now. All those
messages said stuff about
one sized clothing, dried
fish and green herbs, wine...
Huh. It doesn't make sense.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
好吧。所有這些
資訊都提到了
均碼的衣服、乾魚
和綠色藥草、葡萄酒...
嗯。這說不通。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?
I could have
told you that!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼...？
我本來可以
告訴你的！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Wait, wait.
Let's mark all the
clue locations again
on your Mini-Map.
Okay, we've got four
dots around Payon.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
等等，等等。
讓我們再次在
你的小地圖上
標記所有線索的位置。
好的，我們在斐揚
周圍有四個點。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Alright, now if
I connect and intersect
all the lines, there's
a point in the middle.
Why don't you check
this middle point, eh?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
好的，現在如果
我把所有線連線並相交，
中間會有一個點。
你不妨檢查一下
這個中間點，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Now, this location
is a house, and I know
it's pretty random, but
it's all we got. Heck,
all these clues make
less sense than this!
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
現在，這個位置
是一棟房子，我知道
這很隨機，但
這是我們僅有的線索。天哪，
所有這些線索
比這個還說不通！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh yeah?
Well listen, I dunno,
but this looks to be one
of those situations where
two heads are better than one.
I think we oughta team up~
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
哦是嗎？
好吧聽著，我不知道，
但這看起來像是那種
兩個人比一個人好的情況。
我想我們應該合作~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, how's it goin'
looking for that one
piece of the tablet?
It's a lot of trouble,
but I guess that's the
case with all treasure.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
嘿，尋找那塊
石板碎片的情況如何？
這很麻煩，
但我想所有寶藏
都是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh, so all of those
items came in handy?
I don't believe it! So
this puzzle actually
makes sense?! So
what'd the slab say?
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
哦，所以那些
物品都用上了？
我不信！所以
這個謎題
真的有道理？！那
石板上面寫了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
''Compassionate one?''
Oh hey, there's a giant
stone statue over in the
Archer Village that fits
that description perfectly!
You should check it out.
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
“慈悲之人？”
哦嘿，在弓箭手村
那邊有一尊巨大的
石像，完全符合
那個描述！
你應該去看看。

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, you really ought
to check out the huge
stone statue over in the
Archer Village. Now that
I think about it, it's the
perfect hiding place!
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
嘿，你真的應該
去看看弓箭手村那邊
那尊巨大的石像。現在
我仔細想想，它是
完美的藏匿地點！

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, this is great!
You actually found the
next piece of the tablet!
You better take this back
to Chilias'Tyus right now~
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
嘿，太棒了！
你真的找到了
下一塊石板碎片！
你最好現在
把它帶回給奇利亞斯·提烏斯~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Oh. And um, thanks
for being willing to pay
me in cash for all those
little bitty clues. I won't
forget your help, pal~
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
哦。還有，嗯，謝謝
你願意用現金
支付我那些
小線索的費用。我不會
忘記你的幫助，夥計~

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Hey, be careful if
you manage to find that
Hellion's gem. I dunno if
it's true, but maybe old
Tyus was right. Maybe it
does hold a wicked power...
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
嘿，如果你設法找到了
那個地獄之石，要小心。我不知道
這是不是真的，但也許老
提烏斯是對的。也許它
確實蘊含著邪惡的力量...

scripts.text:
[Grout'he]
Life sure is a lot
less tense without
having debt to worry
about. I could get
real used to this...
scripts.translation:
[格勞特赫]
沒有債務要擔心，
生活確實輕鬆多了。
我可能會
習慣這種生活...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this is where
Grout'he told me to look.
Ooh, there's something
written on the ceiling. Um,
let's see... ''This garment
is one size fits all.''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這就是格勞特赫
告訴我要找的地方。
噢，天花板上
寫著什麼。嗯，
讓我看看...“這件衣服
是均碼的。”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's it...?
Hopefully this will
make more sense once
I find more clues. I hope.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就這樣...？
希望找到更多線索後
這能更有意義。希望如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this is the place
that Grout'he told me about.
Let's see, there's an engraving
here that says, ''I used to pray for peaceful days here.'' Okay.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這就是格勞特赫
告訴我的地方。
讓我看看，這裡有一個
雕刻，上面寫著，“我曾經在這裡
祈禱和平的日子。”好的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Man...
This better not be
one of those puzzles
that looks easy once
I get the answer. Well,
if I ever get it, that is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...
這最好不要是那種
一旦得到答案
就顯得很容易的謎題。好吧，
如果我能得到的話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So... Dried fish all
around me. This is getting
to be nonsense. Let's see,
this message says, ''Green
Herbs are very useful for
getting rid of fish smells.''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
周圍全是乾魚。這簡直太荒唐了。讓我看看，這條線索寫著：“綠色藥草對於去除魚腥味非常有用。”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I got it...!
Whoever made up
these clues must be
some sort of crazy man!
It's the only explanation!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了...！
想出這些線索的人
一定是個瘋子！
這是唯一的解釋！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, the last
place I have to check.
It's a big old vat with a
message here too. Now
let me see, there should
be a message here too. Ah--!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，這是我要檢查的
最後一個地方。
這是一個巨大的舊木桶，
這裡也有條線索。讓我
看看，這裡應該也有條線索。啊——！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This says, ''What will it be?
Wine or Grape Juice? Oh,
but I much prefer wine.'' Okay,
what does this have to do with
that Hellion's gem? Weird...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
上面寫著：“你會選什麼？
葡萄酒還是葡萄汁？哦，
但我更喜歡葡萄酒。”好吧，
這和那個混蛋的寶石有什麼關係？真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Am I missing something?
I think I really need help in
figuring this out. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是不是漏掉了什麼？
我覺得我真的需要幫助
才能解開這個謎題。嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, the floor around
here doesn't seem very
solid. Maybe there's
something underneath?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，這裡的地板
看起來不太結實。
也許下面有什麼東西？

scripts.text: Just check the floor.
scripts.translation: 檢查地板

scripts.text: Dig through the dust.
scripts.translation: 撥開灰塵

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the floor,
but are unable to find
anything that resembles
a clue to the location
of the Hellion's gem
or a tablet piece.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你檢查了地板，
但沒能找到任何
類似於地獄獸寶石位置
或石板碎片線索的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh man, there's
so much dust! What
can I do about all of
this nasty dirt in the air?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪，灰塵太多了！
我該怎麼處理空氣中
這些討厭的灰塵？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, there are all these
clues Grout'he found. It sucks,
but I'll use this Grape Juice
to sort of keep this dust from
kicking up. And if I put my morals^FFFFFFa^000000 on hold, I'll cover my face...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，這裡有格勞特赫
找到的所有線索。真糟糕，
但我可以用這瓶葡萄汁
來防止灰塵飛揚。如果我暫時放下我的道德^FFFFFF觀^000000，我就可以用這個遮住臉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...With this Skirt of Virgin.
Oh, and I can use this Stone
Heart to prop any floor boards
I tilt while I look underneath
this floor. Oh hey! I found it!
It's... It's another clue!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...用這條韓服。
哦，我還可以用這塊石心
來支撐我傾斜的地板，
以便檢視地板下面。哦，嘿！我找到了！
這是...這是另一條線索！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, wait...
I can't read the
engraving on this
stone slab, it's way
too old. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，等等...
我讀不懂這塊
石板上的雕刻，
它太古老了。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cover the surface
of the slab and begin
to rub a Green Herb over
it. Fortunately, the juice from
the Green Herb makes the
engraving appear more clearly.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你用手捂住石板表面，
開始用綠色藥草擦拭。
幸運的是，綠色藥草的汁液
使雕刻變得更加清晰。^000000

scripts.text:
[Stone Engraving]
^4D4DFF''This has been entrusted to
the care of the compassionate
one so that my friends may
find peace. To he who finds
this, remember that avarice
knows no bounds. --Tyus.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[石刻]
^4D4DFF“這被託付給慈悲之人，
以便我的朋友能找到安寧。
找到此物的人，請記住貪婪
是沒有止境的。——提烏斯。”^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where did I leave
all that stuff I got from
Grout'he? Let's see,
there was a Green Herb,
a Stone Heart, Grape Juice
and one Skirt of Virgin...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把從格勞特赫那裡
拿到的東西都放在哪裡了？
讓我看看，有一株綠色藥草，
一塊石心，一瓶葡萄汁
和一條韓服...

scripts.text:
[Stone Engraving]
^4D4DFF''This has been entrusted to
the care of the compassionate
one so that my friends may
find peace. To he who finds
this, remember that avarice
knows no bounds. --Tyus.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[石刻]
^4D4DFF“這被託付給慈悲之人，
以便我的朋友能找到安寧。
找到此物的人，請記住貪婪
是沒有止境的。——提烏斯。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Stone Engraving]
^4D4DFF''This has been entrusted to
the care of the compassionate
one so that my friends may
find peace. To he who finds
this, remember that avarice
knows no bounds. --Tyus.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[石刻]
^4D4DFF“這被託付給慈悲之人，
以便我的朋友能找到安寧。
找到此物的人，請記住貪婪
是沒有止境的。——提烏斯。”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請站住！
您攜帶的物品過多，背包空間不足，無法領取獎勵。請騰出一些背包空間後再來接受挑戰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, here's a huge
stone statue. This
must be what Grout'he
was telling me about.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，這裡有一尊巨大的
石像。這一定是格勞特赫
告訴我的那個。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
^4d4dffYou must...
You must be...^000000
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
^4d4dff你一定是...
你一定是...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the--?
There's a voice
inside my head!
And it's not even mine!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該死——？
我的腦海裡
有個聲音！
而且那根本不是我的聲音！

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
You who have come
for the Tablet Piece,
I shall judge whether
or not you are worthy.
Answer this one question.
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
為了石板碎片而來的人，
我將審判你
是否配得上它。
回答這一個問題。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
You are in a situation
in which you will die,
but if you cause the death
of another person, you will
surely save yourself. So...
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
你正處於必死的境地，
但如果你殺死另一個人，
就能確保自己活下來。
那麼...
你會怎麼做？

scripts.text: I will kill to survive.
scripts.translation: 我會殺人求生。

scripts.text: I have no choice, but to die.
scripts.translation: 我別無選擇，只能赴死。

scripts.text: I won't kill, but I'll find a way to live!
scripts.translation: 我不殺人，但我會想辦法活下去！

scripts.text: I'll ask that person if it's okay to kill him.
scripts.translation: 我會問那個人，殺他是否可以。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
There is a primal truth
to your answer. However...
You have chosen poorly.
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
你的回答中蘊含著
原始的真理。然而...
你選錯了。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
There is a kindness and
compassion in your answer
that is indeed rare. However,
where is the respect for your
own life? If you are that willing to throw it away, you are no hero.
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
你的回答中有著
罕見的仁慈與慈悲。然而，
你為何不尊重自己的生命？
如果你如此輕易地放棄生命，
你便不是英雄。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
Yes. Love for all life,
including your own, is
a trait that all true heroes
must have. You have chosen...
Wisely. Please, take this into
your capable hands, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
是的。愛一切生命，
包括自己的生命，
是所有真正英雄
必須具備的特質。
你做出了...
明智的選擇。請，
冒險者，將這交給
你可靠的雙手。

scripts.text:
^3355FFA stone slab at the foot
of the statue slides open,
revealing a piece of the
tablet that will lead you
to the Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF石像腳下的石板
滑開了，
露出了一塊石板碎片，
它將指引你
找到赫利昂的寶石。

scripts.text:
[Echoing Voice]
The veneer of honesty in
your answer is surpassed by
your own cowardice. You have
chosen extremely poorly...
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
你回答中虛偽的誠實
遠不及你的怯懦。
你選得極差...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe piece of tablet
that you have is shining
with light as if in response
to something in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你手中的石板碎片
正閃爍著光芒，
彷彿是對
周圍某種事物的回應。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHold it right there!
You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF請站住！
您攜帶的物品過多，背包空間不足，無法領取獎勵。請騰出一些背包空間後再來接受挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm? Oh, pardon me.
I didn't notice you. I was
far too occupied thinking
deep important thoughts
that your puny little mind
couldn't possibly fathom.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
嗯？啊，抱歉。
我沒注意到你。我剛才
正全神貫注地思考
極其重要的深奧問題，
你那渺小的頭腦
根本無法理解。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
That...
That eerie glow...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
那...
那詭異的光芒...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
You! Identify yourself
and explain how you came
about to get those tablet
pieces! Now answer me!
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
你！報上名來，
並解釋你是如何
得到那些石板碎片的！
現在回答我！

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Ah, forgive me. You're
helping Chilias, are you?
I see. So you must be here
to seek my help in finding
the final piece, am I correct?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
啊，請原諒。你是
在幫助希利亞斯，對吧？
我明白了。那你一定是來
尋求我的幫助，
尋找最後一塊碎片的，
對嗎？

scripts.text: Shut up, I know you have it, so give it!
scripts.translation: 閉嘴，我知道你有，快給我！

scripts.text: Yes, please help me.
scripts.translation: 是的，請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Such insolence!
Huh. I suppose Chilias
may have misjudged you
when he entrusted you with
this important mission. Huh.
A reevaluation is in order...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
如此無禮！
哼。我想希利亞斯
在把這項重要任務
託付給你時，
可能看走眼了。哼。
看來需要重新評估一下...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Of course, in the
interest of mankind,
I shall help you. But first,
I have a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
當然，為了
人類的利益，
我會幫助你。但首先，
我有件事想請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
My student in the Geffen
Tower has not reported back to
me about his research project,
so I would like for you to find
him and retrieve the report
for me. Not a big deal, right?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
我在吉芬中央塔的
學生還沒有向我彙報
他的研究專案，
所以我想請你找到他，
並把報告拿給我。
這不是什麼大事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
The title of his report
should be, ''^4D4DFFMonster Life
in the Geffen Area^000000,'' so
please remember that.
Ah, and my student's
name is Enoz.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
他的報告標題應該是
“^4D4DFF吉芬地區的魔物生態^000000”，
請務必記住這一點。
啊，對了，我的學生
名叫埃諾茲。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please bring me the
report entitled, ''^4D4DFFMonster
Life in the Geffen Area^000000,''
from my student Enoz in
the Geffen Tower. Thank
you, I appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
請從吉芬中央塔的
我的學生埃諾茲那裡，
把標題為“^4D4DFF吉芬地區的魔物生態^000000”
的報告帶給我。
謝謝，我很感激你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Oh dear me...
I'm unfathomably thirsty...
There's no way I can do any
serious thinking with such
a dry, parched throat...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
^333333*咳咳*^000000 哎呀...
我渴得難以忍受...
喉嚨這麼幹渴，
我根本無法進行
嚴肅的思考...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Oh, a White Potion?
Yes, may I please have
one? Ahh, most refreshing~
You may not be such a bad
person after all! Now shall I help you find that tablet piece?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
哦，白色藥水？
是的，能給我一瓶嗎？
啊，真清爽~
看來你也不是
什麼壞人嘛！
那麼，現在我可以
幫你尋找那塊碎片了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Of course, in the
interest of mankind,
I shall help you. But first,
I have a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
當然，為了
人類的利益，
我會幫助你。但首先，
我有件事想請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
My student in the Geffen
Tower has not reported back to
me about his research project,
so I would like for you to find
him and retrieve the report
for me. Not a big deal, right?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
我在吉芬中央塔的
學生還沒有向我彙報
他的研究專案，
所以我想請你找到他，
並把報告拿給我。
這不是什麼大事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
The title of his report
should be, ''^4D4DFFMonster Life
in the Geffen Area^000000,'' so
please remember that.
Ah, and my student's
name is Enoz.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
他的報告標題應該是
“^4D4DFF吉芬地區的魔物生態^000000”，
請務必記住這一點。
啊，對了，我的學生
名叫埃諾茲。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Oh...! Still so...
Exasperatingly thirsty!
If I only had something
cool, refreshing and with
a high restorative value
to quench this thirst!
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
哦...！還是這麼...
令人惱火的口渴！
要是有一杯清涼、
清爽且恢復力強的飲料
來解渴就好了！

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please bring me the
report entitled, ''^4D4DFFMonster
Life in the Geffen Area^000000,''
from my student Enoz in
the Geffen Tower. Thank
you, I appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
請從吉芬中央塔的
我的學生埃諾茲那裡，
把標題為“^4D4DFF吉芬地區的魔物生態^000000”
的報告帶給我。
謝謝，我很感激你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm? What's that strange
expression on your face?
Prank? Oh please. Such
chicanery is beneath me...
But even if I did play a joke, believe me. It builds character.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
嗯？你臉上那奇怪的
表情是怎麼回事？
惡作劇？拜託了。
這種小把戲
配不上我...
但即使我開了玩笑，
請相信我。這能磨練性格。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
First and foremost,
I want to test you to see
if you are worthy of this
tablet piece. I want to see
for myself if you are a person
of honor. Someone of character.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
首先，
我想測試一下你，
看看你是否配得上
這塊碎片。
我想親眼確認
你是否是一個
有榮譽感的人。一個有品格的人。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Oh yes, I accidentally
took this Master Science
Reference Book from Enoz,
so would you please return it
to him for me? Oh, and please
bring back 1 Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
哦對了，我不小心
從埃諾茲那裡拿走了
這本《大師科學參考書》，
請幫我把它還給他好嗎？
哦，對了，請順便
帶1顆藍色魔力礦石回來。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received the
incredibly heavy tome,
the Master Science
Reference Book.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你獲得了
那本極其沉重的
《大師科學參考書》。^000000

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please deliver the Master
Science Reference Book to
Enoz, and come back to me
with 1 Blue Gemstone.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
請把《大師科學參考書》
交給埃諾茲，
然後帶著1顆藍色魔力礦石
回來見我。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Thank you. You've
brought the book to Enoz
and delivered a Gemstone
to me as I've asked. Now,
there is one final test...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
謝謝。你已經
把書交給了埃諾茲，
並按我的要求
把寶石原石帶給了我。
現在，還有最後一項測試...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Answer this question.
Where is the abode of the
departed souls with a shining
silver roof that is mentioned
in the third part of the ballad
of Grimnir? Well, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
回答這個問題。
在格林尼爾的
第三部分歌謠中提到的，
那座擁有閃耀銀色屋頂的
逝者居所，
是在哪裡？嗯，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Ah, well met, well met.
You are as well learned as
you are brave. As promised,
you may have this piece of
the tablet, which I've already found. The clues were too simple...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
啊，幸會，幸會。
你不僅勇敢，
而且學識淵博。
如我所承諾的，
你可以拿走這塊碎片，
我已經找到了。
線索太簡單了...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Please send my regards
to my dear friend, Chilias,
who has dedicated his life
to sealing the evil within
the Hellion's gem.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
請代我向
我親愛的朋友希利亞斯
問好，
他畢生致力於
封印地獄犬寶石中的邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Bwahahaah! Only
a superior mind could
know the answer to such
a question! Go forth and
learn the answer, else
I cannot help you, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
哇哈哈！只有
卓越的智慧
才能知道
這個問題的答案！
去吧，去尋求答案，
否則我無法幫助你，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Ah, I've heard that
Enoz received the Master
Science Reference Book
from you. But did you remember
to bring me a Blue Gemstone?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
啊，我聽說
埃諾茲已經從你那裡
收到了《大師科學參考書》。
但是，你記得
給我帶藍色魔力礦石嗎？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm. You should visit
Chilias and determine
your next course of action,
now that you have all four
of the pieces of the tablet.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
嗯。既然你已經
集齊了四塊碎片，
你應該去拜訪希利亞斯，
並決定你下一步的行動。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Hm? Did you need
me to combine all four
pieces of the tablet and
make it whole again? Oh.
All this time I thought you
knew how to do it. Alright.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
嗯？你需要我
把四塊碎片
拼合在一起，
使其恢復完整嗎？哦。
我一直以為
你知道該怎麼做。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
As a matter of fact,
I was planning on using
the Blue Gemstone you gave
me to do this. But since you
never really asked... In any
case, let me concentrate.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
事實上，
我原本打算用
你給我的藍色魔力礦石
來做這件事。
但既然你從未真正要求過...
無論如何，讓我集中精神。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Shadows remembered by time.
Help me retrieve the forgotten
stories that have been scattered in the wind. Right here. Right now.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
被時間銘記的陰影。
幫助我找回那些
散落在風中的
被遺忘的故事。
就在此刻。就在此地。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
...
Okay...
That was tough.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
...
好了...
真是費了一番功夫。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
That was tough
complete tablet.
Please bring this
safely back to Chilias.
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
這塊完整的石板
真是來之不易。
請把它安全地
帶回給希利亞斯。

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Wait, take a look!
There's a map on the back
of the tablet. Although the gem
is already embedded within the
tablet, who knows where this map may lead? Perhaps Hellion Revenant?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
等等，快看！
石板背面有一張地圖。
雖然魔力礦石
已經鑲嵌在石板中了，
但這張地圖會通向哪裡呢？
也許是暗黑祭司的巢穴？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
I don't know if Chilias
told you, but the name of
the monster that guards and
follows this gem is Hellion
Revenant. But why mark its
location on this tablet?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
希利亞斯可能沒告訴你，
守護並追隨這塊魔力礦石的魔物
名叫暗黑祭司。
但為什麼要在石板上
標記它的位置呢？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Well, it will be dangerous, but
I'm sure that you're strong enough to confront this monster. I believe
it was the wish of this tablet's creator for someone to defeat
the Hellion Revenant...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
雖然會很危險，
但我相信你有足夠的實力
去對抗這隻魔物。
我想，這塊石板的創造者
一定希望有人能擊敗暗黑祭司...

scripts.text: Alright, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 沒問題，交給我吧！

scripts.text: I better get this tablet to Chilias...
scripts.translation: 我還是先把石板交給希利亞斯吧...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Well, I'm almost certain
this map will lead you to
Hellion Revenant. Let me
warp you to the location
marked on the tablet's map...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
我幾乎可以肯定，
這張地圖會把你
引向暗黑祭司。
讓我把你傳送到
石板地圖上標記的位置...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Yes, that's true.
Chilias has been waiting
his whole life to seal this
gem. Plus, who knows what
may happen while it is in
your possession?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
是的，確實如此。
希利亞斯一輩子都在等待
封印這塊魔力礦石的機會。
而且，誰知道它在你手中
會發生什麼事呢？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
So, were you able
to deliver the tablet
and the Hellion's gem to
Chilias safely? I hope so...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
那麼，你成功地把石板
和暗黑祭司的魔力礦石
安全地交給希利亞斯了嗎？
希望如此...

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
So, were you able
to deliver the tablet
and the Hellion's gem to
Chilias safely? Ah, and
how has my friend been?
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
那麼，你成功地把石板
和暗黑祭司的魔力礦石
安全地交給希利亞斯了嗎？
啊，還有，我的朋友
最近過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Welshyun]
Heh heh~
Enoz must be
panicking right
about now. Oh,
students are always
good for a laugh...
scripts.translation:
[威爾什雲]
嘿嘿~
埃諾茲現在肯定
急得團團轉吧。哦，
學生總是能帶來
不少樂趣...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe piece of tablet
that you have is shining
with light as if in response
to something in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你手中的石板碎片
正閃爍著光芒，
彷彿是對
周圍某種事物的回應。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
It's gone, it's gone!
Where the hell did it go?!
Oh man, who could have
taken it? Wait, was it... You?!
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
不見了，不見了！
到底去哪了？！
天哪，是誰拿走的？
等等，是你嗎？！

scripts.text: Actually, Welshyun sent me.
scripts.translation: 其實是威爾什雲派我來的。

scripts.text: No way man, don't go nuts.
scripts.translation: 別亂想，冷靜點。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
My mentor, Welshyun?
Huh. Is there a report
I haven't submitted to him
yet? So what was it called?
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
我的師父，威爾什雲？
嗯。難道還有
我沒向他提交的報告？
那叫什麼名字來著？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
''Monster Life in
the Geffen Area?''
Oh no. My mentor took
that three days ago!
Is he still up to his
old tricks again?
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
《吉芬地區的魔物生態》？
糟糕。我師父
三天前就取走了！
他是不是又在
搞什麼小動作？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Awww nuts!
Where the heck is
my Master Science
Reference Book? 
It was right here
three days ago...
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
該死！
我的《大師科學參考書》
到底去哪了？
三天前它明明
還在這裡...

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
{0}?
I haven't completed
any research related
to that subject. Or did I?
Anyway, I need the exact
name of the report you want!
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
{0}？
我沒有完成過
與該主題相關的研究。
還是說我忘了？
總之，請告訴我
你想要的那份報告的準確名稱！

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Nuts?! Oh, you wanna
see crazy, is that it?! You
wanna see insaaaane?!
Cuz I'll go freakin' medieval
if you keep bothering me!!
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
該死？！哦，你想
看看什麼叫瘋狂，是嗎？！
你想見識一下
真正的瘋癲？！
如果你繼續打擾我，
我會讓你見識一下
什麼叫發瘋的！！

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
My mentor Welshyun's
been playing jokes again,
so you better go talk to him.
Damn. Where is that Master
Science Reference Book?
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
我的師父威爾什雲
又在惡作劇了，
你最好去和他談談。
該死。那本《大師科學參考書》
到底去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Oh hey, I remember you~
So did my mentor send you
to me again for some reason?
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
哦嗨，我記得你~
所以，我師父又因為
某種原因把你派給我了？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou cautiously hand Enoz the
Master Science Reference Book.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地將
《大師科學參考書》
遞給埃諾茲。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Yes! Oh yes!
This is the book
I lost three days
ago! Thanks so much!
Now I can finally finish
this research project that--
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
是的！噢是的！
這就是我
三天前丟失的那本書！
太感謝了！
現在我終於可以完成
這個研究專案了——

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Wait, the page I really
need is missing! And there's
some sort of note... Umm...
^333333''Enoz, I think this page
is worth at least one Apple
Juice. Right? --Welshyun.''^000000
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
等等，我真正需要的那一頁
不見了！而且上面
還有張便條... 嗯...
^333333“埃諾茲，我覺得這一頁
至少值一瓶蘋果汁。
對吧？——威爾什雲”^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
NOooOOoOo!
Not agaaaaain!
Why is he always
playing these pranks?!
Apple Juice! I need
some Apple Juice!
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
不OOOOO！
又...又來了！
為什麼他總是
搞這些惡作劇？！
蘋果汁！我需要
一些蘋果汁！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like it's time
to get 1 Blue Gemstone,
and then bring it back
to Welshyun the Sage.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF看來是時候
去弄1塊藍色魔力礦石，
然後把它帶回給
賢者威爾什雲了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Gone! It's gone!
Where did the book
I really need go to?
Oh no oh no oh no oh no!
Waaaaaah, I'm gonna cry!
scripts.translation:
[埃諾茲]
不見了！它不見了！
我真正需要的那本書
到底去哪了？
天哪天哪天哪天哪！
哇啊啊啊，我要哭了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAmongst the wild bushes
and overgrown grass, you
see a large rock slab that
resembles a door. As you
come closer, you can see a
groove on the rock's surface.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在雜草叢生的灌木叢中，
你看到了一塊巨大的岩石板，
看起來像一扇門。當你
走近時，可以看到岩石表面
有一個凹槽。^000000

scripts.text: Insert the Tablet.
scripts.translation: 插入石板

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou insert the tablet into
the rock's groove and the
Hellion's gem begins to hum
and glow. The rock slides open,
revealing an engraved message
on the ground for you to read.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你將石板插入
岩石的凹槽中，地獄之石
開始嗡嗡作響併發光。岩石
滑開了，露出地面上
刻著的一段文字供你閱讀。^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''To you who have found this
place, I reveal the truth about
the Hellion Revenant. It was
never a devil, like we believed, but a human being, slowly
corrupted by the darkness
of the Hellion's gem.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF“致發現此地的你，
我向你揭示關於暗黑祭司的真相。
它從來不是我們以為的惡魔，
而是一個人類，被地獄之石的
黑暗力量逐漸腐蝕。”^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''I learned this horrible
truth too late. Already,
I can feel the darkness
welling up within me.
It is all I can do to trap
myself in this chamber
before I lose all reason.''^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF“我得知這個可怕的真相
為時已晚。此刻，
我已經能感覺到黑暗
在我體內湧動。
我只能將自己囚禁在這個
密室中，以免我失去理智。”^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''I failed and it's too
late for me, but I hope
someone in the future
can seal the Hellion gem's
dark power. And I hope that
someone will grant me the
sweet release I crave...''^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF“我失敗了，對我來說
已經太遲了，但我希望
未來能有人封印地獄之石的
黑暗靈魂之力。我也希望
有人能賜予我我所渴望的
解脫...”^000000

scripts.text:
^4D4DFF''Brave hero, I beg of
you. Please kill me and
bring salvation to my soul.
Please release me so that
I can finally join my friends.
^FFFFFF_^000000
^FFFFFFOOOOOOOOOOO^4D4DFF-Tyus''^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF“勇敢的英雄，我懇求
你。請殺了我，
拯救我的靈魂。
請釋放我，讓我
終於能去和朋友們團聚。
^FFFFFF-^000000
^FFFFFFOOOOOOOOOOO^4D4DFF-泰斯”^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou do nothing.
And nothing happens.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你什麼也沒做。
然後什麼也沒發生。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe tablet in your
hands begins to shine
with light, responding
to something in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你手中的石板
開始發出光芒，
似乎對周圍某種東西
做出了反應。^000000
